method: Read-only official en-US catalog and Video Slots filter (tid 59), then exact Game Details for gid 205 down to 1. A published Game is matched against files tracked in baseline HEAD by normalized current title and provider pg-soft; numeric IDs and duplicate names require individual review before import. Counts are a baseline before the next game commit.
limitations: Homepage counters differ from the live filter/API counts and are treated as separately observed labels, not proof of catalog completion.
The official catalog API returns 156 detail records while its Video Slots filter lists 201 unique pgids; 10 filter pgids were not resolved by numeric route 1–205 and require separate research.
Disabled numeric records are excluded from the active intake cursor. Filter-only IDs are unresolved, not assumed to be current public slots.
Exact-game image, Demo, duplicates and full publication closure are still required for every missing enabled Game.
